e: Doctor Strange tears his universe apart trying to save Christine.
Strange Supreme feeds captured heroes and villains into the Forge, trying to rebuild his universe and Christine.
Strange Supreme helps the Watcher gather the Guardians of the Multiverse, then keeps watch in his own ruined universe over Killmonger and Zola, sealed in a pocket dimension.
Now the living soul of his restored universe, Strange strips the Eminence, the Incarnate and the Executioner of their power.

item.r: Marvel Super Hero Adventures: Frost Fight!
e: Marvel Super Hero Adventures: Frost Fight!
Loki and the Frost Giants come for the holidays.
Miguel O'Hara's Spider-Society keeps its headquarters here, and Miles learns about canon events.
Miguel O'Hara's assistant Lyla tells him his device for crossing into other universes works, and he picks a place to visit.
Grieving his daughter Hope, Hank Pym shrinks down and kills Fury's Avengers candidates one by one, until Fury and Loki expose him.
The Watcher brings Natasha from Ultron's ruined world here, and she steals Loki's scepter and subdues him with it.

item.title: Spider-Man, Survivor
rows: Black Panther: The Last Stand in Wakanda

e: Gwen Stacy's world, where she was bitten instead of Peter Parker.
Gwen's father, a police captain, learns she is Spider-Woman.
Nick Fury assembles a team to stop the Chitauri.
The Avengers go to Wakanda when the Chitauri come back for it.
In the Old West, Shang-Chi and Kate Bishop hunt the Hood, who turns out to be Xialing.
A plague spreads from the Quantum Realm and turns the Avengers into the walking dead.
Kamala, Kate and Riri set out from New York across a ruined Earth while Wanda rules the dead, and only Kamala makes it to the North Institute in Ohio, where she meets Melina, Alexei and Yelena.
Zemo and John Walker run the drifting Raft as a haven for survivors, until zombie Namor breaks in and kills Walker.
Blade Knight wins the survivors entry to New Asgard by revealing Khonshu, and they escape aboard an Asgardian ship as Thor holds off Wanda.
In the final battle in Paris, Wanda's army swarms the Infinity Hulk, and a zombified Thor kills Blade Knight.
Killmonger saves Tony Stark from a Ten Rings ambush, builds vibranium drones with him, then kills T'Challa and Rhodey in a staged fight.
The Watcher pulls Killmonger out of Wakanda just as Pepper, Shuri and the Dora Milaje close in, taking him into the Guardians of the Multiverse.

item.title: Queen of the Dead
rows: Queen of the Dead: A World Remade

e: Tony Stark raises an ancient temple and wakes the Mandarin.
Ant-Man leads the Avengers against Ultron and Kang.
District Attorney Grant Gardner fights the Scarab as Captain America.
A new sheriff investigates disappearances in a swamp guarded by the Man-Thing.

item.title: Party Thor
rows: Jane Foster: The Thunder Next Door

e: Teenage Tony Stark's armor saves his life when his father's plane goes down, and he becomes Iron Man.

item.title: Star-Lord T'Challa
rows: Black Panther: The Long Way Home

e: Ben Reilly, a private eye who was once the Spider, is pulled back in by Silvermane and Dr. Faber.
Ogden drugs Ben and brings him to Dr. Faber's lab, where she finds a cure, and Ben escapes with it after Silvermane raids the lab and Dirk Leyden kills Faber and Ogden.

item.title: Blade Knight
rows: Blade Knight: Last Light of the Moon

e: Nick Fury trains a young Peter Parker with a team of teenage heroes.
Iron Man reassembles the Avengers against the Red Skull's Cabal.
Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H.#2
The Hulk leads a team of gamma heroes and films their adventures.
The Avengers face Ultron, the Inhumans' arrival and Zemo's Thunderbolts.
Doctor Strange and the Hulk go into the Dream Dimension on Halloween.
The Beyonder pulls pieces of worlds together into Battleworld.
The Fantastic Four face Doctor Doom, the Mole Man and Galactus.
Ego's son Peter Quill crash-lands in New York, and Peggy Carter and Howard Stark assemble a team to stop him.
Steve Rogers is frozen in the ice and wakes decades later to stop the Red Skull.
Tony Stark brings his technology to Japan, and Zodiac turns it against him.
Logan goes to Japan to rescue Mariko Yashida.
The X-Men go to Japan to find kidnapped mutants.
Blade hunts Deacon Frost across Asia.
Tony Stark is framed by Ezekiel Stane and goes on the run.
Black Widow and the Punisher go after Leviathan.
Yondu's Ravagers take T'Challa instead of Peter Quill, and he grows up to be Star-Lord.
The Watcher pulls Star-Lord T'Challa from his fight with Ego into the Guardians of the Multiverse, then returns him, and Peter Quill joins the fight.
